mentions.name: C# command-line invoice generator
mentions.description: A command-line invoice generator written in C# that reads the invoice contents from a JSON file and produces a PDF. It is not open-sourced.
mentions.problem: The author needed an invoicing tool after discontinuing a SaaS that had provided invoicing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently built an invoice generator (not open sourced) for my own needs. I built mine because I needed something when I discontinued a SaaS that had provided it. Mine is written in C# and uses a JSON file to define the contents of the invoice. It's run from the command-line and just produces the PDF.
